# #3701: Patch: the effects tests share one cue-end helper and one planning setup in place of 59 local copies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The tests that check that the board's visual effects end on time each carry their own copy of the same two small helpers. One works out when an effect finishes; the other sets up the effect planner under test. There are 59 such copies, and they have drifted apart. Some forget that a projectile or a shot takes time to fly, so in those tests a flying effect that ran far too long would still pass. This change keeps one copy of each helper, shared by every test, so the timing check means the same thing everywhere and the next effect written can't slip past it. No player sees a difference. The maintainer and the bot get about 400 fewer lines and a timing check they can trust.

## Why
- R200 holds every effect cue to ending within `FX_MAX_TAIL_MS` of its entry's end. Only tests enforce that bound. Outside tests, `FX_MAX_TAIL_MS` is read only by `fx/cards/stinkyscape/chaosCalls.ts`. Each test works out a cue's end with an `endOf` helper.
- `function endOf(cue: FxCue)` is copied in 28 test files under `apps/web/src/fx/`, besides the two exported copies in `apps/web/src/test/signatures.ts:25` and `test/signaturePass.ts:43`. Hashing the 28 copies gives six versions:
  - 14 match the shared one.
  - 4 have no `projectile` or `shot` case: `fx/setPieces.test.ts:93`, `fx/flavorEntrances.test.ts:122`, `fx/terminus/terminus.test.ts:85` and `fx/cards/stinkyscape/scan.test.ts:24`.
  - 4 have no `shot` case: `fx/anomaly.test.ts:47`, `fx/cardFx.test.ts:62`, `fx/entrances.test.ts:69` and `fx/starship.test.ts:55`.
  - `fx/flavorExits.test.ts:112` leaves the particles' life off a flight.
  - `fx/starshipMoments.test.ts:68` adds a `conceal` case.
- `projectile` and `shot` cues carry `flightMs` and no `durationMs` (`fx/types.ts:74`, `:101`). A copy without their case falls to `default` and counts such a cue's end as its delay alone, so that file's R200 assertion (`setPieces.test.ts:164`, `starship.test.ts:231`, `anomaly.test.ts:137`, …) cannot fail for a flight that runs long.
- This is a trap waiting for the next effect, not a miss today. None of the planners those nine files test emits the kind its copy leaves out, as far as I could find. The starship's shots (`fx/starship.ts:576`) are checked in `starshipMoments.test.ts`, whose copy counts them. But the effects layer is under heavy work (#3604 to #3610), and that is exactly when a copy gets reused for a planner it doesn't fit.
- `function envOf()` is copied in 31 test files, besides the two exported copies. It comes in three shapes: no argument (13 copies), an `over: Partial<FxPlanEnv>` (15, two of them with a `card` lookup of their own) and an `intensity` number (3).

## Proposal
- Keep one `endOf`, in `apps/web/src/test/signatures.ts`, and have `signaturePass.ts` import it instead of keeping its own. It counts `projectile` and `shot` as their flight plus `FX_MAX_PARTICLE_LIFE_MS`, as today's shared copy does.
- Add a type-level check next to `endOf`: the kinds it treats as flights must be exactly the `FxCue` kinds that carry `flightMs` (`Extract<FxCue, { flightMs: number }>["kind"]`). A new flying cue kind then fails `typecheck` until `endOf` counts it.
- Keep one `envOf(over: Partial<FxPlanEnv> = {})` there too. The `intensity` form becomes `envOf({ intensity })`, and the two `card` lookups pass `card` through `over`.
- Replace every local copy with an import. `starshipMoments.test.ts` keeps its `conceal` exception as a line at its call site, since `signaturePass` already leaves `pull` and `conceal` out of R200 (`signaturePass.ts:84`, `:100`).
- If the stricter `endOf` turns a test red, that is a real R200 miss. Fix the cue's timing in the same pull request; never restore a weaker copy.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/test/signatures.ts`, `apps/web/src/test/signaturePass.ts` and `apps/web/src/test/setPass.ts`.
- The 41 test files under `apps/web/src/` that hold a local `endOf` or `envOf`. All but `test/setPass.ts` are under `fx/`.
- R200 (`spec/rulings/R0200.md`) and SPEC §10.10. Tests only: no production file changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A search for `function endOf(` and `function envOf(` under `apps/web/src` finds only the shared definitions.
- [ ] A unit test of the shared `endOf` covers a burst, a projectile, a shot, a shake and a cue with `durationMs`.
- [ ] A type-level assertion in `signatures.ts` ties `endOf`'s flight kinds to the `FxCue` kinds that carry `flightMs`.
- [ ] No assertion is removed or loosened, and each touched file keeps its number of `it(` calls.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` and `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/fx src/test` pass.

## Size and risks
Wide but simple: 41 test files, all mechanical edits, about 400 lines removed net, and no production code.

Risks:
- The main risk is the one it is meant to find. A test that passed only because its copy didn't count a flight turns red. That is an R200 miss, fixed in the same change.
- It may conflict with the effects work in flight (#3607 to #3610), which touches some of these files. It is best built when that queue is quiet, or split by directory.

   ```ts
   /** The cue kinds that fly: a `flightMs`, no `durationMs`, and a burst where they land (R200). */
   const FLIGHT_KINDS = ["projectile", "shot"] as const;
   type FlightKind = (typeof FLIGHT_KINDS)[number];
   type Same<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? ([B] extends [A] ? true : false) : false;
   /** Type-level: a new `FxCue` kind with a `flightMs` fails `typecheck` here until FLIGHT_KINDS, and so `endOf`, counts it. */
   const _flightKindsAreTheFlightCues: Same<FlightKind, Extract<FxCue, { flightMs: number }>["kind"]> = true;
   const flies = (cue: FxCue): cue is Extract<FxCue, { kind: FlightKind }> => (FLIGHT_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(cue.kind);

   /** Where a cue ends, in ms after its entry starts (R200's bound is D + FX_MAX_TAIL_MS). */
   export function endOf(cue: FxCue): number {
     if (flies(cue)) return cue.delayMs + cue.flightMs + FX_MAX_PARTICLE_LIFE_MS;
     switch (cue.kind) {
       case "burst":
         return cue.delayMs + FX_MAX_PARTICLE_LIFE_MS;
       case "shake":
         return cue.delayMs;
       default:
         return cue.delayMs + ("durationMs" in cue ? cue.durationMs : 0);
     }
   }
   ```

The `cardFx.test.ts:166` call, `envOf(next === undefined ? {} : { next })`, is already an object and needs no change.

5. **Replace each local copy** among the 40 files:
   - Delete `function envOf(...) {…}` and `function endOf(...) {…}` (through the closing `}` at column 0).
   - Delete the one-line arrow copies: `const envOf =` in `battleship`, `beats`, `tempoBeats`, `terminus` and `flavorExits`.

Use `../test/signatures.ts` from `fx/*.test.ts`, `../../test/` from `fx/cards/*.test.ts`, `fx/motifs/` and `fx/terminus/`, and `../../../test/` from `fx/cards/<dir>/`. Place it with the other relative imports, beside the `test/fixtures.ts` import where there is one.
   - Run `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src` and prune the imports it flags (the table lists the expected ones).
   - A throwaway script outside the repo is fine, but check every diff.

6. **Two files whose copy had its own `card` lookup.** Add a thin wrapper that passes `card` through `over`. A differently-named helper is allowed under #2215.
   - `fx/entrances.test.ts`: `const legendaryEnv = (over: Partial<FxPlanEnv> = {}): FxPlanEnv => envOf({ card: () => LEGENDARY_FACTS, ...over });`. Rename its `envOf(` call sites to `legendaryEnv(`, including the default `env: FxPlanEnv = envOf()` in `planAll`.

   - Behaviour is unchanged. Rejected alternative: spelling `card` out at about 11 call sites.

7. **`fx/starshipMoments.test.ts`.** Its copy had a `conceal` case, since the stage ends a conceal, not the tail. In `expectBounded`, replace the `endOf` assertion with `const end = cue.kind === "conceal" ? cue.delayMs : endOf(cue);` and `expect(end, …).toBeLessThanOrEqual(D + FX_MAX_TAIL_MS)`, keeping the message. Add a comment: "the stage's: the board's next view ends it (R200); it paints nothing". Leave the lowercase `env` arrows in this file and in `starship.test.ts`. They have another name and are out of scope.

8. **`apps/web/src/test/signatures.test.ts` (new) and `helpers.test.ts`.**
   - New file: write the tests listed under Tests. Do not put `R200` as a word in any `it(` or `describe(` title, because `spec check` would then demand the file in `proven_in`. Cite it in a comment only.

     - Add `{ name: "endOf", home: "test/signatures.ts", source: signaturesSource }` and the same for `envOf` to `SHARED`.
     - Append two planted lines, `"function endOf(cue: FxCue): number {"` and `"const envOf = (): FxPlanEnv => ({});"`, with `"line 13: endOf", "line 14: envOf"` added to the expected list.
     - Extend the header comment and the failure message to name `test/signatures.ts`, and add `endOf or envOf` to the last `it(` title. Add no new `it(`.
   - This keeps the "one shared definition" criterion true after this change instead of checking it once by search.

9. **Run the fx suite and fix red.** If a test goes red, the cue really exceeds R200. Read the failing label (kind, D), open the planner, and make `delayMs + flightMs <= D`. `fx/starship.ts` around line 576 is the model: `flightMs: Math.max(0, D - delayMs)`. Fix it in the planner, never in the test, and record the decision. Only the "weak" files could go red. Their planners are not known to emit a flight, and `flavorExits` already asserts `delayMs + flightMs <= D`, so the stricter bound should hold.

- **`helpers.test.ts` reads every `*.test.ts` file.** A leftover arrow copy (`const envOf = (`) fails it, so the grep in Done-when must be clean.
- **In-flight effects work (#3607 to #3610) may touch the same files.** Do not fix conflicts speculatively. Merge only if the harness reports one.
- **`apps/web/src/test/*` is read by the web CI job.** Nothing else (the wire files, the Rust crates) is affected.
- **No gate catches an unrewritten caller.** The 14 numeric callers are caught only by `typecheck`.

## Open questions

- The issue counts 41 files and 31 `envOf` copies. The tree has 40 files with a local copy, five of them as `const envOf =` arrows, and this plan covers all of them. No decision is needed.
- Lowercase `env` arrows with another name (`starshipMoments.test.ts`, `starship.test.ts`) are copies the issue's search does not cover. They are left alone. A person may want a follow-up.
